meta.title: Dead Before Dawn

victim.name: BrijMohan Valentine
victim.description: Charming, controlling host whose family owns the cabin. He kept a quiet tally of what everyone owed him, in money and in secrets.

meta.tone: claustrophobic cabin-in-the-woods dread, Until Dawn horror, creaking dark and long silences
meta.premise: Five friends come to a secluded cabin in the woods. One of them is found dead in the basement cellar, and one of the others was caught sleeping with the victim's sister and the victim's girlfriend. The rest must find the killer before help arrives.

suspects.name: Rafe Kincaid
suspects.description: Brij's oldest friend and favourite rival. Easy grin, worse decisions. Caught tonight with Brij's sister, and weeks ago with his girlfriend.
suspects.public_alibi: Says he spent that hour locked in the upstairs bathroom, sick on whiskey. Nobody saw him come out.
suspects.motive: Brij found out about him and Tara tonight, and about Mina weeks ago, and swore at dinner to ruin him.
suspects.secret: You owe Brij more money than you could ever repay. Your name fills a whole page of his tally book.

suspects.name: Tara Valentine
suspects.description: Brij's younger sister. Sharp, sleepless and finished with living in his shadow.
suspects.public_alibi: Smoked on the porch with Jonah, watching the treeline, the whole hour.
suspects.motive: Brij caught her with Rafe tonight and threatened to tell their father, who still pays her rent.
suspects.secret: You forged your father's signature to drain the family trust. Brij found the bank letters tonight, so you drugged his whiskey and pushed him down the cellar steps.

suspects.name: Mina Sol
suspects.description: Brij's girlfriend of three years. Brittle smile, ring finger bare since dinner.
suspects.public_alibi: Packing upstairs to leave at first light. Her footsteps creaked overhead the whole time.
suspects.motive: Brij read her old messages to Rafe aloud at dinner and laughed.
suspects.secret: This afternoon you tore your page out of Brij's tally book and burned it in the stove. It listed every debt he held over you.

suspects.name: Jonah Pike
suspects.description: Brij's business partner. Soft voice, steady hands, the one who drove everyone up here.
suspects.public_alibi: Smoked on the porch with Tara the whole hour.
suspects.motive: Takes full control of the company they built together if Brij is gone.
suspects.secret: You were not on the porch. You walked up the ridge for signal and called a lawyer about cutting Brij out of the company. You were gone twenty minutes, and Tara was alone.

world.killer_method: Tara crushed her sleeping pills into Brij's whiskey while his glass sat on the counter at midnight. At ten past one he texted her to bring the letters to the cellar. With Jonah away on the ridge, she crossed from the porch, followed Brij down and pushed him as he swayed on the steps, then went back to the porch before Jonah returned. Motive: Brij had found the trust withdrawals she forged in their father's name and meant to tell him at breakfast.

clues.text: Brij's whiskey glass lay by the cellar steps. A chalky white film clings to the bottom, and it smells bitter.
Tara's bottle of sleeping pills is nearly empty. The label says it was filled two days ago.
Jonah admits he left the porch to call someone from the ridge. For twenty minutes around one o'clock, Tara was alone.
A bank letter from Brij's jacket shows a trust withdrawal signed in his father's name. In the margin Brij wrote: 'Not Dad's hand. T.'
Fresh red clay on the cellar steps, the same clay as the porch planters. Whoever went down came from the porch.
Brij's phone lay under the cellar steps. His last text, sent at ten past one, went to Tara: 'Cellar. Bring the letters.'
A rust-brown stain soaks the cuff of Rafe's shirt, balled up in the bathroom bin.
A scorched scrap of notebook paper from the stove, in Brij's handwriting. Mina was the last one seen at the stove.

items.name: Brij's keyring
items.description: Heavy iron keys on a brass ring. The smallest one fits the cellar safe.

items.name: Wind-up torch
items.description: Its beam is weak but steady. The dark gets a little smaller.

items.name: Brij's tally book
items.description: A black notebook of names and sums in Brij's tidy hand. One page is torn out.

items.name: The truck's radio
items.description: Mostly static. Now and then a ranger's voice, very far away.

finale.proof: Inside the safe are the trust papers, and pages of their father's signature practised over and over in Tara's hand. The bitter glass, her empty pills, the porch clay, the twenty minutes alone, his last text: it was Tara Valentine.
finale.frame: Rafe's bloodied cuff. The bathroom door, unlocked long before he says he came out. A debt to Brij bigger than anyone's. It all points at Rafe Kincaid.

solved.title: The Sister
solved.epilogue: The vote lands on Tara, and she does not deny it for long. When the rangers' lights crawl up the road, {survivors} are waiting with the letters. Rafe's stained cuff was his own blood, from a glass he broke while sick. Mina's ash was only her own page, burned to be free. {victim} died for a forged signature, and his sister will answer for it.

wrong_culprit.title: The Wrong Door
wrong_culprit.epilogue: The vote lands on {accused}, and the cabin turns on them until help arrives. Tara stands at the window and says nothing. The stained cuff was a cut hand, and the ash in the stove was a page Mina burned to be free. By the time anyone reads Brij's last text, Tara has a lawyer and a story. {victim}'s killer drives home with the family name intact.

culprit_escapes.title: Help Arrives Too Late
culprit_escapes.epilogue: Nobody names the killer before dawn. When the rangers arrive, the cellar safe is open and the trust papers are ash. Rafe's cuff and Mina's stove meant nothing in the end. Tara rides back to the city in the front seat, quiet and composed. {victim}'s killer was in the cabin the whole time.
